title: rosa coriifolia var. cinerea
intro: Rosa coriifolia var. cinerea, commonly known as Kashmir rose or Himalayan rose, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rosa coriifolia var. cinerea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
